facts.text: Northeastern's College of Professional Studies offers cooperative education (co-op) alternating terms of academic study with full-time employment in the U.S. or globally.

sources.title: Experiential Learning Information
sources.quote: What is Co-op? Co-op is an educational program in which you alternate terms of academic study with terms of full-time employment in positions related to your academic and/or career interests in the U.S. or globally.
